```{r example, eval = x == "a"}
1 + 1
```

```{r example2, eval = n > 1}
1 + 1
```

```{r arithmetic, eval = n + 1 > 2, echo=FALSE}
1 + 1
```

```{r spaced, eval = n > 1 warning=FALSE}
1 + 1
```

```{r strings, eval = x == "a, } ( b" && y != 'c, ]', echo=TRUE}
1 + 1
```

```{r nested, eval = grepl(")", x) && n > 1, warning=FALSE}
1 + 1
```

```{r, eval = n > 1   }
1 + 1
```
